pages.text: Look at the $(item)output block$() with Engineer's Goggles. It shows the ore count, the $(item)height$(), the $(item)fuel$() left, the time left in ticks, $(item)Reinforced$() if it is, then both tanks. Red lines say why it is idle:

$(li)$(item)Structure incomplete$(): fewer than 3 good layers. Check corners, edges, the empty centre and the bottom centre brick, layer by layer.$(li)$(item)No fuel$(): add coal coke dust.$(li)$(item)No flux$(): add limesand.

$(li)$(item)No Blast Furnace Hatch in the walls$(): add one, or you have two and the second cut the tower.$(li)$(item)The hatch holds no Hot Air$(): the stove is not delivering, or the hatch holds another fluid.$(li)$(item)Output tank full$(): pump the steel or slag out.
If the furnace stops with hot air in the hatch, the hatch may have less than 20 mB: your stove is too small for this furnace. Slag is not waste: cast it into slag blocks.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
